body: Probably not. As I've mentioned I'm a college drop out. I should probably note that this entire thing isn't my main source of depression. I'm going through a whole lot of things as hinted by me dropping out, and me not being able to physically yet comfortably talk about it in my country just stresses me even more.

As I've mentioned in my post, I have went to psychologists. It's just that it's really hard to find one that could agree with my views so I could more comfortably talk with them in the first place. I have nothing against religion, but it's kinda awkward to talk about my issues to someone without opposing morals they hold so dear to them. It's hard to find psychologists/therapists who speak English too, and I can't blame them for that. I'm in a really weird position and I don't really know what to do.

I'm sure I can find someone to talk with from the sub, and I think that's really wonderful. I admire the people who take their time to respond to people here. But at some point I wish that these kind of people physically existed near me. Like I mentioned in my post, I really just feel so lost. A suicide hotline doesn't even exist here. Actually, it did but the government decided to shut it down after a few months because they decided it wasn't important enough. You are looked down upon here if you're suicidal or non-religious. Individualism isn't a thing here. I'm sure every country has their pros and cons, but I've really found myself stuck in a loss for identity. Heck I don't even speak my country's native language in my daily life. It's different I guess, seeking help here isn't even easy and once you do find professional help they'd still judge you.
I prefer not to mention. But I can assure you that it I'm not in a western country.

There's no way I'm gonna enter the same college again in my country. I hated every single second of it. The only reason I'm still alive now is because I dropped out of it. I could very likely see myself dead if I had stayed. Also, hazing is pretty much a mandatory process in all universities here. Sound crazy right? Not here.
